_readme: All resume text lives here. Edit this file and push to GitHub; the live site updates automatically. The page shows each job's 'key' bullets (3 is best) and hides 'creative', 'highlights', and 'earlier_roles' behind a 'More' link. Work items with "featured": true show first; the rest appear under 'See all work'. The AI chat reads everything in this file, shown or not.
_work_help: Each item in 'work' is one card. Optional: 'image' (a picture you put in public/work/, e.g. "/work/poster.jpg"), 'video' (a YouTube or Vimeo link; YouTube also gives the card its picture), 'link' (any web page), 'role', 'collaborators', 'details'. category must be one of: Design, Video, Storytelling, Marketing, Events, Collaborations, Technology, AI.
name: Herbert Gracia
role: Brand & Creative Director, now building with AI
tagline: I build brands from concept to market: two apparel brands co-founded, 21 years leading marketing and creative at the University of San Francisco's Fromm Institute, and now certified by USF in Applied Agentic AI.
about: My strength is connecting brand strategy, creative thinking, and marketing with execution, from concept and product development through campaign, production, digital platforms, sales, and customer experience.

My background spans brand strategy, creative direction, art direction, integrated marketing, visual storytelling, video, product development, manufacturing, sales, technology, AI, and experiential marketing. I also use AI and generative AI in campaign development, content creation, audience messaging, research, social media marketing, and creative workflows.
